body.title: Page-cutting module
body.summary: Add the vscode-free transcript-window module: latestWindow(transcript, pageRows) and pageBefore(transcript, before, pageRows), each returning { firstIndex, rows }, with the one rule (PAGE_ROWS back from the end of the range, then back to the nearest user row within a further PAGE_ROWS, else the plain cut), `before` clamped to 0..length, and the fixed constants (PAGE_ROWS = 100). Nothing uses it yet.
acceptanceChecks: A transcript no longer than one page is returned whole with firstIndex 0
A long transcript returns at most two pages of rows, starting at a user row when one is within reach, else the plain last page
pageBefore clamps `before`; at 0 it returns no rows and firstIndex 0
Walking pageBefore from the latest window to 0 reproduces the whole transcript, no row skipped or repeated
The sizes are named constants; no setting is read

tests.name: latestWindow: a transcript no longer than one page is returned whole with firstIndex 0
latestWindow: a long transcript returns its last page, moved back to the start of the turn when a user row is within one more page, and never more than two pages of rows
latestWindow and pageBefore: with no user row within reach the cut is the plain page; consecutive pages cover every row exactly once
pageBefore: before is clamped to 0..length; at 0 it returns no rows and firstIndex 0
walking pageBefore from the latest window down to 0 reproduces the whole transcript in order with no row skipped or repeated
